enrollment.gate_hint.zh-CN: 请使用已录入的指纹验证

enrollment.subtitle.default.en: Press the sensor six times, shifting slightly each time.
enrollment.subtitle.default.zh-CN: 请按压传感器六次，每次稍微移动手指。

enrollment.subtitle.switch.en: This finger will only switch between the two hosts.
enrollment.subtitle.switch.zh-CN: 此指纹仅用于在两台主机之间切换。

enrollment.hint.center.zh-CN: 将指腹按在传感器中央

enrollment.hint.back_to_center.en: Back to center, press once more

enrollment.state.place_finger.en: Place your finger on the sensor...
enrollment.state.place_finger.zh-CN: 请将手指放在传感器上…

enrollment.state.lift_finger.en: Lift your finger, then press again...
enrollment.state.lift_finger.zh-CN: 抬起手指，然后再次按压…

enrollment.state.overlap.en: Too similar — shift your finger and press again
enrollment.state.overlap.zh-CN: 位置过于相似，请移动手指后再次按压

enrollment.error.disconnected.en: Device disconnected before enrollment finished. Reconnect the device and try again.
enrollment.error.disconnected.zh-CN: 指纹录入完成前设备已断开连接。请重新连接设备后再试。
